ValidationRule.description: Change reason is required while updating slot generator value - HRP-12011
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Slot_Generator__c), NOT($User.FirstName & ' ' & $User.LastName = 'Automated Process'), OR( ISBLANK( Slot_Generator_Change_Reason__c ), NOT(ISCHANGED(Slot_Generator_Change_Reason__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Slot Generator Change Reason is required and has to be different while updating Slot Generator
